newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Santander unit completes purchase of Bancoquia.
newsitem.headline: Santander unit completes purchase of Bancoquia.

text.p: Spain's Santander Investment, a unit of Banco Santander, formalized Monday the purchase of a 55 percent stake in Colombia's Banco Santander Colombia, formerly known as Bancoquia, stock exchange sources said.
The Spanish group paid 155.9 billion pesos ($141.08 million) for 48.7 million shares in the bank, Colombia's eighth largest in terms of assets, a spokesman for Corredores Asociados brokerage said.
Bancoquia changed its name to Banco Santander Colombia earlier this month in preparation for the takeover, which was agreed in principle in May.

Brewing giant Bavaria retains a 26 percent stake in the bank after the sale of its 55 percent holding, but has given Santander Investment the option to buy the rest of its stake at an unspecified future date.
